text: Next, we tested whether the bounce could erase lopsidedness. Shear and torsion dilute at exactly the same rate, so their ratio is frozen. A bounce occurs only when shear is already subdominant. The bounce itself performs zero ironing out. It cannot create an axis memory, and it cannot erase it. Survival remains undetermined because the only proposed eraser is particle production, and that step is heuristic rather than derived.
